source_refs.note: Osmoregulators: a main subheading of 13.2.1 Osmoregulators and Osmoconformers, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 4-4.

blocks.text: Jo janwar apni jism ki rutoobaton mein pani aur ghule maddon ki miqdar khud qaboo kar sakte hain, woh osmoregulators hain. Bahar ka mahol badalta rahe tab bhi yeh andar ki miqdar ek jaisi (constant) rakhte hain. Is ke liye yeh kai tareeqe istemal karte hain, maslan namak ki active transport (tawanai laga kar namak ko andar ya bahar le jana), namak jama karna aur pani bachana. Pani aur khushki (aquatic aur terrestrial) ke zyada tar vertebrates osmoregulators hain.

blocks.prompt: Osmoregulators aur osmoconformers ki tareef ek ek misal ke saath kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Osmoconformers jism ki rutoobaton ko mahol ke mutabiq rehne dete (samundari invertebrate jaise starfish, ya hagfish); osmoregulators mahol kuch bhi ho rutoobatein mustaqil rakhte (meethe pani ki machhli ya insaan).

items: Osmoconformers: andar ki concentration mahol ke barabar (isotonic); samundari invertebrates, hagfishes, sharks, rays.
Osmoregulators: mahol badle tab bhi andar ki concentration khud qaim rakhte hain; zyada tar vertebrates.
